repos.name: SimpleVirtualAvatar
repos.description: SimpleVirtualAvatar (SVA) is a lightweight C++ application for managing 2D avatars in real time. It allows you to animate character sprites, simulate conversation, and blink using a simple system of states and assets.

recent_commits.message: Add translations for road building (Road.csv), remove extra code (RoadOverlay), change outline color for roads (RoadRenderer)
Fix movement bug and change one-per-time-direction movement to two-per-time-direction (InputHandler, Movement), fix crossroad corner creating (Arm, RoadCorners)
Fix storage of positions for roads (RoadGeometry)

Add RoadGraph as road container with node/edge lists, poly and bounds caches, intersection edge splitting, Near/Snap/OnLane/ArmsAtPoint queries and RoadChanged invalidation (RoadGraph.cs), Add RoadJunction resource storing Id/Position/Level/LinkData/CustomLinks (RoadJunction.cs), Add RoadEdge resource with start/end node and arm ids, lanes/lane width/one-way/width/level and CurveData serialization (RoadEdge.cs), Add Arm wrapper computing origin, outward tangent, half width, reach, lane counts and Covers/LanePoint helpers (Arm.cs), Add Link readonly record struct for from/to arm and lane (Link.cs), Add RoadSnap capturing position/foot/direction/node/edge/free/lane/flow for builder snapping (RoadSnap.cs), Add RoadLinks generating default lane links by turn angle, mapping lanes, fixing coverage, validating exits/entries/reachability and sanitizing saved link data (RoadLinks.cs), Add ClearPlan clipping each edge polyline against a rect, tracking inside/outside offsets, cut points and accumulating cost/length with bridge multiplier (ClearPlan.cs), Add RoadEdit journal holding added/removed/built edges, added/removed nodes and per-node link before/after snapshots for undo/redo (RoadEdit.cs), Add RoadGeometry helpers for line/arc/arc-curve/hermite/reverse curves, tessellated polylines, length/bounds, nearest/point-at/tangent-at, sub/offset, segment intersection and min radius (RoadGeometry.cs), Add RoadCorners sorting arms by angle, skipping near-parallel pairs, filleting corners with clamped touch radius and fanning rim triangles (RoadCorners.cs), Add RoadGrid routing with 8 directions, two-leg solve, optional heading-constrained first leg and turn rounding by radius (RoadGrid.cs), Move road builder into Tool layer keeping input/modes/cost while delegating drawing to renderer and HUD to overlay (RoadBuilder.cs), Add RoadRenderer drawing road polylines, corner fills, rims and debug output from graph version (RoadRenderer.cs), Add RoadOverlay updating Info/Error/Level/Hint labels from builder state (RoadOverlay.cs), Delete clear mode with rect selection, plan preview, commit and cost deduction (RoadBuilder.Clear.cs), Delete parallel mode with reference segment, offset polyline, gap stepping and validation (RoadBuilder.Parallel.cs), Delete turn mode with markers, link toggling and reset (RoadBuilder.Turns.cs), Change Builder node to wire Renderer, Overlay and InputHandlerer and add Renderer/Overlay/Texts children with Info/Error/Level/Hint labels (Level.tscn), Change Movement node to take InputHandlerer pointing at Player/Input (Level.tscn), Change Test node script from TestBalance to TestSomething (Level.tscn), Change SaveData road network field to RoadGraph and add Seed field with matching constructor (SaveData.cs), Add Seed resource generating ulong via GD.RandRange with fixed-value constructor (Seed.cs), Add Version.FromEngine reading major/minor/patch/status from Engine.GetVersionInfo (VersionData.cs), Change Core exit to stamp engine version into save before saving (Core.cs), Rename RecurseSave to ReflectSave and switch dictionaries/arrays/method args to collection expressions (ReflectSave.cs), Add GodotObject extensions for IsDebug, CurrentSaveData and CurrentConfigData via Core.Instance (GodotObjectExtensions.cs), Change FileUtils load to print decoded content when debug (FileUtils.cs)
Add icon, create project for including assets, remove extra flags, fix application title, add hardcoded theme
Change collecting artefacts from all the folder to executable file (FineScaler.Desktop)
Add build script for GitHub Actions (building for Windows and Ubuntu with build number counter)
fix bug and create Css class-parser
